svg.aria-label: How Druks works: a trigger starts an app workflow. Each durable step saves its result in Postgres. An agent step runs Claude Code or Codex in an isolated Drukbox sandbox. A gate pauses the workflow until a person or a system answers in Slack, the dashboard, the chat or Claude Code, then the workflow resumes. Events go to the run history, the live feed, notifications and webhooks.
